name: memory-pulse
description: Memory for Claude that keeps every correction and shows it when it matters. Notes cannot instruct the agent, and any edit to the record shows.
long_description: memory-pulse keeps a project's memory as a ledger file on your machine: what happened, what caused it, and every correction with the value it withdrew and the value that replaced it. Claude reads it through four tools: pulse (what the memory says about a topic), recall, remember and execute. A note that reads like an instruction is refused or quarantined, never shown as a command, and any edit to an earlier row breaks the chain and shows. Point several agents at one message board file and they can post, read and reply to each other; nothing on the board wakes or prompts an agent. The free tier needs no key.

tools.name: pulse
tools.description: What the memory says about a topic: findings, causes and the corrections in force, each citing its ledger row.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Find recorded events related to a question, with the exact recorded links.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Record a finding or a correction (the withdrawn value and its replacement).

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run a small read-only program over the memory and return only the answer.

memory_folder.title: Memory folder
memory_folder.description: Where the ledger file (events.jsonl) is kept. Use a project's .memory-pulse folder to share memory with Claude Code in that project.

license_key.title: Licence key
license_key.description: Optional. Leave blank for the free tier.

board_file.title: Agent message board file
board_file.description: Optional. A board file shared with other agents (for example ~/.memory-pulse/board.jsonl). Set it to add the board_post and board_read tools; leave blank to keep the board off.
